name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source user and authentication platform with an admin dashboard and API, backed by PostgreSQL and ClickHouse.

alerts.message: Sign in to the dashboard with ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The API is served on the api. subdomain of the app domain, so that hostname must resolve to this server too.

Emails such as verification, magic links and password reset need SMTP (set per project in the dashboard) and a Freestyle API key in HEXCLAVE_FREESTYLE_API_KEY, with the sandbox snapshot bootstrapped as described in the self-host guide.
